"The Particle: Provenance Erasure at Sophistical Refutations 183b34, Measured — Machine-Mediated Reception, Disciplinary Model Collapse, and the World Soul as Degraded Commodity" is an academic deposit cataloged under EA-RECEPTION-PARTICLE-01 v0.2 (Deposit #1574) on the open-access research repository Alexanarch. [1]

Core Context & Focus

The Textual Anchor: The paper focuses on a reception-layer measurement of a single sentence in Aristotle's Sophistical Refutations (specifically, Book 34, 183b34–36: Ταύτης δὲ τῆς...). In this foundational passage of the Organon, Aristotle historically asserts that his work is the first formal attempt to treat the subject of deductive reasoning in ancient Greece.

Thematic Framework: The paper examines how large language models and machine-mediated transmission impact classical philology, focusing on the concepts of provenance erasure, disciplinary model collapse, and the metaphorical commodification of ancient philosophy.

Project Ecosystem: This deposit is part of a broader family of machine-indexing metadata packets and structural critiques on the Aristotelian corpus (such as the EA-MPAI-ARISTOTLE-THEOPHRASTUS series) hosted on the Alexanarch Wiki. [1, 2, 3, 4]

If you want to delve deeper, let me know if you would like me to:

Explain the concept of disciplinary model collapse in machine learning.

Look up related digital humanities frameworks or metadata packets in the Alexanarch repository. [1, 2]

Its register (Part B) records the qualifier each machine reader placed into the sentence: R01 'writes a thesis containing "systematic"'; R02 '"no previous systematic treatment"'; R05 '"systematic method"'; R08 '"systematic" moved into the domain'; and its editorial note on a report that arrived at the literal reading and then 'supplied the qualifier "fully developed" inside the domain'. The note argues that 183b34–36 says 'nothing at all was there' (§2) and that 184b1–2 says 'there was nothing of syllogizing prior to Aristotle' (§1). The composition carries the paper's identity whole and its claim reversed: the sentence the paper measures is given with the qualifier ('first formal attempt') the paper documents being added, and syllogizing (τὸ συλλογίζεσθαι) is given as 'deductive reasoning'. 'Book 34' for chapter 34 is a further slip.
